shared_elements: upright monolithic stone block/pillar as the carved support
shallow low-relief carving with rounded, raised outlines on a single flat face
curved sweeping line/band crossing the shaft horizontally
isolated motifs set against a large empty ground
justification: Both are tall upright stone blocks bearing shallow, softly rounded low relief on one broad face, and in each case a long curving raised band sweeps across the shaft with sparse motifs above blank ground. The decisive difference is subject and organisation: A shows a single quadruped in profile on an otherwise plain slab, while B is an anthropomorphic figure whose whole body is the monument, with a carved head, arms and a vertically stacked series of discs and ornaments.
